Kids Eat Free (or Cheap) Miami Restaurant Guide

By
Ana-Sofia DuLaney
-
August 2, 2026
Facebook
Twitter
Pinterest
ReddIt
Email
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 7:05
    Instaread

    Don’t you sometimes wish your kids could eat free? That you could go out and not spend double on dinner because you’re going as a family? 

    I hope this list of kids eat free (or at least cheap) comes in handy to make your family outings a little bit sweeter. Search by the day of the week below or scroll to the bottom to find deals every day!

    Monday 

    BurgerFi: Every Monday, kids get a free kids’ meal with the purchase of an adult meal. Kids 12 and younger. 

    Anthony’s Coal Fired Pizza: Every Monday kids 12 and under eat free with a $10 minimum purchase. The kids’ meals include a 10-inch cheese pizza or kids’ spaghetti and meatballs. This deal is only valid for dine-in!

    Outback Steakhouse: On Monday, kids can get a free kids’ meal with the purchase of an adult entrée. Dine in and mention ‘FREE JOEY MEAL’ or order online and redeem with code JOEYFREE.

    Dadeland Mall and The Falls have reprised their summer offer for Kids Eat Free! For a limited time only, every Monday (at Dadeland) and Tuesday (at The Falls) June 8-August 17, 2026, Children ages 12 or under receive a free kids’ item or meal with purchase of an adult item on entree from participating eateries when this ad is mentioned. New restaurants have entered the chat and are bringing great deals to families!

    Mondays at Dadeland:

    This is valid Mondays and dine-in only!

    • Avocados Food: One free item, corn cup with $20 purchase
    • Ben’s Pizza: Buy any slice and get one classic cheese for your child!
    • Charleys Philly Steaks: One free kids’ meal with a purchase of one entree at full price. (Minimum purchase of $10)
    • Churromania: One free 8-cripsy CrispyMania for kids with the purchase of any selection of churros.
    • Jrk!: Free kids meal with purchase of adult entree
    • Kelly’s Cajun Grill: Kids size portion with purchase of normal combo
    • Macy’s Cafe: Free kids chicken tender meal and small toy with purchase of adult meal
    • Niko Niko Boba: BOGO: Buy one, get one free.
    • OMG Brigadeiros: With purchases over $18, kids receive a complimentary Rainbow Brigadeiro Bite.
    • Pei Wei Asian Express: Choice of one side and one entree with purchase of an adult combo meal
    • Dick’s House of Sport: They even have a deal where you don’t get food but if you spend $50 you receive a free kids rock climbing session!

    Tuesday 

    Tuesdays at The Falls:

    Enjoy Kids Eat Free Tuesdays at The Falls from June 2nd to August 31st.  Please reach out to individual restaurants for their offerings if not listed below!

    • Arcade Time Entertainment 
    • Bulla Gastrobar: Receive a complimentary kid’s meal with the purchase of an entrée. 
    • Churromania
    • Freddo
    • Haagen Dazs
    • Mr. Bean
    • Los Ranchos
    • PF Changs– free kids meal from the kids menu with the purchase of an adult meal.
    • Pummarola Pastificio Pizzeria 
    • Sokai Sushi Bar – For every adult entree you get a free kids meal from the kids menu
    • True Food Kitchen 

    Other Tuesday Deals!

    Miller’s Ale House: One free kid’s meal with purchase of a $10 food menu item. Limit 2 per table.

    Denny’s on 19313 South Dixie Highway offers their kids eat free discount on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4-10 PM. Up to two kids meals free with the purchase of an adult entrée of $6 or more. No other discounts apply (including military). Denny’s on 12000 N Kendall Drive only offers their kids eat free deal on Tuesdays, same restrictions apply. Because all Denny’s are franchises, please call your local one to verify their participation! 

    Two Brothers: Kids eat free on Tuesdays with the purchase of an adult entrée. All day long (during normal operating hours; 13740 Southwest 84th Street, Miami, FL)

    Wednesday

    Sports Grill: Kids get one free meal from the kids’ menu on “Kids Wednesdays” with the purchase of an adult meal! Great midweek break! This deal is available at the Sunset, Bird Road, Kendall, South Miami, Miami Lakes, Pembroke Pines, and Palmetto Golf Course locations.

    IKEA!! Yes! IKEA Family members get up to two kids’ entrees free at the Swedish Restaurant. Now through August 26th!

    Chick-fil-A: Kids eat free from 5-7 on Wednesdays at participating locations. 13001 S Dixie Hwy, Pinecrest, FL  33156 is confirmed to participate.

    Duffy’s Sports Grill: Kids get a free kids meal with the purchase of adult entree!

    Thursday

    Denny’s on 19313 South Dixie Highway offers their kids eat free discount on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4-10 PM. Up to two kids meals free with the purchase of an adult entrée of $6 or more. No other discounts apply (including military).

    Friday

    There aren’t specific deals for Fridays but check the list below for the restaurants that offer everyday kids eat free or cheap deals! You can head to one of those.

    Saturday

    PINCHO: Every Saturday and Sunday all summer long, kids eat free at PINCHO with the purchase of an adult entrée. Limit one kids meal per adult entrée. Offer valid Saturdays and Sundays, July 11 – August 9, 2026.

    Sunday

    Shake Shack’s Chicken Sundays, Free Chicken Shack with $10 Min 

    Here’s fun for the whole family, Shake Shack will be offering free chicken shacks with $10 purchases with the code CHICKENSUNDAY.  Offer only valid for qualifying orders placed at a kiosk in-Shack, or for delivery or pick-up via the Shake Shack Mobile App or shakeshack.com, and fulfilled starting on Sunday, January 4th, and all Sundays subsequently after, through Sunday, December 27th  

    Every day kids eat free or cheap deals:

    Bocas House: Monday to Friday from 3-6 pm, Bocas House offers a free kids meal with each purchase of an adult meal! Valid at Doral and Weston.

    Golden Corral: Kids 3 years of age or younger eat free every night of the week with the purchase of an adult meal! Golden Corral’s America $2.50 Value Deals will feature exclusive monthly offers inspired by America’s 250th birthday.

    IHOP: Kids eat free every day from 4-10 pm with the purchase of an adult entrée!

    Texas de Brazil: Kids 2 years old and under eat free; kids 3 to 5 years old eat for $5; and kids 6 to 12 eat for half-price every day. 

    POC American Fusion Buffet and Sushi: Kids 3 and under eat free; kids 4 to 7 years old pay one-third of the adult price; and kids 8 to 12 eat half price every day.

    Moe’s Southwest Grill: Offer valid for Moe Rewards members for one (1) Kids Meal on us with each purchase of an Entrée.

    Remember that these deals can change at any time so if you have any doubts, ask your local eatery before ordering to confirm. Happy eating!

    Do you have a favorite restaurant that offers a kids eat free or cheap deal? Please share it in the comments below. And be sure to check out our other helpful guides here!
